amortization.basis: Original principal, fixed stored annual rate, calculated EMI; first due one month after start. Not a payment history.

interest.basis: April-March, balances at close of fifth day, stored rate held constant. Opening balance plus recorded contributions only; historical interest credits and rate changes are unavailable. Not posted to balance.

summary.accounting_basis: Positive amounts classified by transaction_type. Cash outflow = expense + investment + loan_payment; transfers excluded from net cash flow. Portfolio snapshots, budget limits, PPF contributions, and scheduled payments are not added to ledger cash flow.

dashboard.balance_basis: Selected month's recorded net cash flow; no opening bank balance exists. Assets and loan balances are current snapshots, not historical valuations.
